annotations.title: Finnish company lookup, PRH trade register

description: Finnish company by business ID (Y-tunnus 0112038-9 or VAT FI01120389) or name, live from the Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH): names incl. parallel and former, legal form, status, bankruptcy, liquidation or re-organisation, registration date, trade, VAT and employer registers, main business line, address, website. Use to verify a Finnish customer or supplier. Register facts only, not a credit report. Example: businessId=0112038-9. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

businessId.description: Finnish business ID (Y-tunnus, 1234567-8) or VAT number FI12345678 (give businessId or name)

city.description: With name: only companies registered in this town (Finnish or Swedish name)

limit.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

name.description: Company name to search for, instead of businessId: up to 10 current companies whose name holds every word
